proves.claim: With gate.endStaleJobs on, release and refreeze of an item with an offered gate job and 12 open shard jobs leave none open and name the reason; with it off they stay open as today.

cli.io-commands-release.release-and-refr.why: Without it, a released or refrozen item's gate job and shards keep running to a stale settle and spend runner time on a candidate that can no longer land.
